# spo_org_news_site (Data Source)

Look up an existing OrgNewsSite object. Set identity to select it.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `identity` (String) Identity used to look up the object.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
- `url` (String) The org news site URL (echoes identity).
